scope: Replace the inverted zte_touch_pdev_unregister stock body with checked child-device release and route shared probe/deinit cleanup through it.
root_cause: The stock body unregisters only when cdev+0xdd0 is NULL. That branch also enters a trap path before attempting platform_device_unregister(NULL); a valid non-NULL child takes the no-op branch and leaks.
The hardened probe dispatcher ensures the synthetic uevent child remains unbound, so the shared unregister routine can safely remove it without invoking zte_touch_remove on the global parent state.

implementation.function: The C implementation returns when tpd_cdev or the child slot is NULL. For a valid child, it clears cdev+0xdd0 and the uevent callback at cdev+0xea0 before calling platform_device_unregister.
implementation.build_selection: The Makefile no longer links zte_touch_pdev_unregister_exact.o; it includes the hardened C implementation. The exact stock assembly remains preserved as historical evidence but is not part of the candidate module.
implementation.shared_cleanup: zte_touch_probe_failure_cleanup now delegates child release to zte_touch_pdev_unregister, so failed probe and normal deinit use the same idempotent path.

validation.zte_touch_deinit_note: Not compared: the stock symbol has no valid KCFI preamble.

limitations: No runtime module load or NX809J hardware teardown test was run.
KCFI validation gates type ID and section; symbol-size parity is intentionally non-gating for hardened functions.
The child unbound property is established by the callback identity guard in the preceding probe lifecycle batch.
